audit_logs_actor_check.name: audit_logs_actor_check
audit_logs_actor_check.value:
("audit_logs"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_logs"."actor_role" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_logs"."system_actor" IS NULL)
        OR ("audit_logs"."actor_user_id" IS NULL AND "audit_logs"."actor_role" IS NULL AND "audit_logs"."system_actor" IS NOT NULL)

pricing_plans_duration_check.name: pricing_plans_duration_check
pricing_plans_duration_check.value: ("pricing_plans"."model"::text = 'FREE') = ("pricing_plans"."duration_cycles" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pricing_plans"."duration_cycles" IS NULL OR "pricing_plans"."duration_cycles" > 0)

wallet_recharges_status_check.name: wallet_recharges_status_check
wallet_recharges_status_check.value:
"wallet_recharges"."status" IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED')
        AND ("wallet_recharges"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("wallet_recharges"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("wallet_recharges"."status" = 'PENDING') = ("wallet_recharges"."completed_at" IS NULL)

dead_letter_events_status_check.name: dead_letter_events_status_check
dead_letter_events_status_check.value:
("dead_letter_events"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "dead_letter_events"."retry_requested_at" IS NULL AND "dead_letter_events"."replayed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("dead_letter_events"."status" = 'RETRY_REQUESTED' AND "dead_letter_events"."retry_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "dead_letter_events"."replayed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("dead_letter_events"."status" = 'REPLAYED' AND "dead_letter_events"."retry_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "dead_letter_events"."replayed_at" IS NOT NULL)

disputes_escalation_check.name: disputes_escalation_check
disputes_escalation_check.value:
("disputes"."escalated_at" IS NULL) = ("disputes"."escalated_by_user_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("disputes"."escalated_at" IS NULL) = ("disputes"."escalation_reason" IS NULL)
        AND ("disputes"."status" <> 'ESCALATED' OR "disputes"."escalated_at" IS NOT NULL)

disputes_resolution_check.name: disputes_resolution_check
disputes_resolution_check.value:
("disputes"."status" IN ('OPEN', 'ESCALATED')) = ("disputes"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("disputes"."status" IN ('RELEASED_TO_VENDOR', 'REFUNDED_TO_CUSTOMER', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'))
          = ("disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL) = ("disputes"."resolution_note" IS NULL)
        AND ("disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL) = ("disputes"."refund_npr" IS NULL)
        AND ("disputes"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "disputes"."escalated_at" IS NOT NULL)

export_jobs_outcome_check.name: export_jobs_outcome_check
export_jobs_outcome_check.value:
("export_jobs"."status" IN ('DONE', 'FAILED')) = ("export_jobs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("export_jobs"."status" = 'DONE') = ("export_jobs"."delivery" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("export_jobs"."delivery" IS DISTINCT FROM 'LINK' OR "export_jobs"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("export_jobs"."file_key" IS NULL OR "export_jobs"."delivery" = 'LINK')
        AND ("export_jobs"."status" <> 'FAILED' OR "export_jobs"."error" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_access_log_copy_number_check.name: invoice_access_log_copy_number_check
invoice_access_log_copy_number_check.value:
("invoice_access_log"."action" = 'PRINT') = ("invoice_access_log"."copy_number" IS NOT NULL)
            AND ("invoice_access_log"."copy_number" IS NULL OR "invoice_access_log"."copy_number" >= 0)

invoices_header_text_check.name: invoices_header_text_check
invoices_header_text_check.value:
btrim("invoices"."seller_name") <> '' AND btrim("invoices"."seller_address") <> ''
            AND btrim("invoices"."seller_phone") <> '' AND btrim("invoices"."buyer_name") <> ''
            AND btrim("invoices"."amount_in_words") <> ''

invoices_vat_amounts_check.name: invoices_vat_amounts_check
invoices_vat_amounts_check.value:
"invoices"."taxable_amount_npr" >= 0 AND "invoices"."vat_amount_npr" >= 0 AND "invoices"."exempt_amount_npr" >= 0
            AND "invoices"."vat_rate_percent" IN (0, 13)
            AND ("invoices"."seller_is_vat_registered"
              OR ("invoices"."vat_amount_npr" = 0 AND "invoices"."taxable_amount_npr" = 0 AND "invoices"."vat_rate_percent" = 0))

ird_pan_checks_state_check.name: ird_pan_checks_state_check
ird_pan_checks_state_check.value:
("ird_pan_checks"."status" IN ('MANUAL_REVIEW', 'RESOLVED')) = ("ird_pan_checks"."review_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("ird_pan_checks"."status" IN ('VERIFIED', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'RESOLVED', 'SUPERSEDED')) = ("ird_pan_checks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("ird_pan_checks"."status" = 'RESOLVED') = ("ird_pan_checks"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_accounts_owner_check.name: ledger_accounts_owner_check
ledger_accounts_owner_check.value:
(("ledger_accounts"."account_type" = 'VENDOR_WALLET') = ("ledger_accounts"."vendor_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("ledger_accounts"."account_type" = 'DRIVER_WALLET') = ("ledger_accounts"."driver_user_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("ledger_accounts"."account_type" = 'GATEWAY_CLEARING') = ("ledger_accounts"."gateway" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("ledger_accounts"."account_type"::text = 'VENDOR_DISPUTE_HOLD') = ("ledger_accounts"."hold_vendor_id" IS NOT NULL))
        AND (("ledger_accounts"."account_type"::text = 'CUSTOMER_WALLET') = ("ledger_accounts"."customer_user_id" IS NOT NULL))

ledger_entries_ad_line_purchase_check.name: ledger_entries_ad_line_purchase_check
ledger_entries_ad_line_purchase_check.value: "ledger_entries"."line_type" NOT IN ('AD_FLAT_FEE', 'AD_ORDER_PREMIUM', 'AD_BUDGET_HOLD', 'AD_BUDGET_RELEASE') OR "ledger_entries"."ad_purchase_id" IS NOT NULL

ad_purchases_budget_check.name: ad_purchases_budget_check
ad_purchases_budget_check.value: ("ad_purchases"."billing_model" = 'PER_ORDER_PREMIUM') = ("ad_purchases"."budget_npr" IS NOT NULL) AND ("ad_purchases"."budget_npr" IS NULL OR "ad_purchases"."budget_npr" >= "ad_purchases"."price_npr")

notification_messages_push_counts_check.name: notification_messages_push_counts_check
notification_messages_push_counts_check.value:
("notification_messages"."recipient_count" IS NULL OR "notification_messages"."recipient_count" >= 0)
        AND ("notification_messages"."push_completed_at" IS NULL) = ("notification_messages"."push_sent_count" IS NULL)
        AND ("notification_messages"."push_completed_at" IS NULL) = ("notification_messages"."push_failed_count" IS NULL)
        AND ("notification_messages"."push_completed_at" IS NULL OR "notification_messages"."push_started_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("notification_messages"."push_sent_count" IS NULL OR "notification_messages"."push_sent_count" >= 0)
        AND ("notification_messages"."push_failed_count" IS NULL OR "notification_messages"."push_failed_count" >= 0)

orders_platform_promo_source_check.name: orders_platform_promo_source_check
orders_platform_promo_source_check.value:
("orders"."platform_promo_discount_npr" > 0) = ("orders"."campaign_opt_in_id" IS NOT NULL)
            AND ("orders"."campaign_opt_in_id" IS NULL) = ("orders"."discount_snapshot" IS NULL)

orders_placed_at_check.name: orders_placed_at_check
orders_placed_at_check.value: CASE "orders"."state" WHEN 'PENDING_PAYMENT' THEN "orders"."placed_at" IS NULL WHEN 'FAILED' THEN true ELSE "orders"."placed_at" IS NOT NULL END

payout_requests_transfer_state_check.name: payout_requests_transfer_state_check
payout_requests_transfer_state_check.value:
"payout_requests"."transfer_state" IS NULL
        OR ("payout_requests"."status" = 'APPROVED' AND "payout_requests"."transfer_state" IN ('PROCESSING_BANK_TRANSFER', 'COMPLETED'))
        OR ("payout_requests"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "payout_requests"."transfer_state" = 'FAILED')

payout_requests_status_check.name: payout_requests_status_check
payout_requests_status_check.value:
("payout_requests"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "payout_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL AND "payout_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL
            AND "payout_requests"."bank_reference" IS NULL AND "payout_requests"."reversal_transaction_id" IS NULL
            AND "payout_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("payout_requests"."status" = 'APPROVED' AND "payout_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND (("payout_requests"."bank_reference" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("payout_requests"."bank_reference") <> ''
                AND "payout_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
                AND "payout_requests"."transfer_state" IS DISTINCT FROM 'PROCESSING_BANK_TRANSFER')
              OR ("payout_requests"."bank_reference" IS NULL AND "payout_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL
                AND "payout_requests"."system_actor" IS NOT NULL
                AND "payout_requests"."transfer_state" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'PROCESSING_BANK_TRANSFER'))
            AND "payout_requests"."reversal_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "payout_requests"."rejection_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("payout_requests"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "payout_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "payout_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_requests"."bank_reference" IS NULL
            AND "payout_requests"."reversal_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)

home_promotions_text_check.name: home_promotions_text_check
home_promotions_text_check.value: ("home_promotions"."title" IS NULL OR btrim("home_promotions"."title") <> '') AND ("home_promotions"."subtitle" IS NULL OR btrim("home_promotions"."subtitle") <> '')

home_promotions_target_check.name: home_promotions_target_check
home_promotions_target_check.value: ("home_promotions"."target_type" IS NULL) = ("home_promotions"."target_value" IS NULL) AND ("home_promotions"."target_value" IS NULL OR btrim("home_promotions"."target_value") <> '')

home_promotions_dates_check.name: home_promotions_dates_check
home_promotions_dates_check.value: "home_promotions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "home_promotions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "home_promotions"."starts_at" < "home_promotions"."ends_at"

settlement_model_change_requests_decisio.name: settlement_model_change_requests_decision_check
settlement_model_change_requests_decisio.value: ("settlement_model_change_requests"."status" = 'PENDING') = ("settlement_model_change_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("settlement_model_change_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("settlement_model_change_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL)

users_email_check.name: users_email_check
users_email_check.value: "users"."email" IS NULL OR ("users"."email" = lower(btrim("users"."email")) AND "users"."email" LIKE '_%@_%')

vendors_admin_suspension_check.name: vendors_admin_suspension_check
vendors_admin_suspension_check.value: "vendors"."status_before_admin_suspension" IS NULL OR ("vendors"."status" = 'SUSPENDED' AND "vendors"."status_before_admin_suspension" <> 'SUSPENDED' AND "vendors"."status_before_debt_suspension" IS NULL)

vendors_pan_verification_check.name: vendors_pan_verification_check
vendors_pan_verification_check.value: ("vendors"."pan_verified_at" IS NULL) = (num_nonnulls("vendors"."pan_verified_by_user_id", "vendors"."pan_verified_by_job") = 0) AND num_nonnulls("vendors"."pan_verified_by_user_id", "vendors"."pan_verified_by_job") <= 1 AND ("vendors"."pan_verified_at" IS NULL OR "vendors"."tax_id" IS NOT NULL)

vendors_billing_cycle_check.name: vendors_billing_cycle_check
vendors_billing_cycle_check.value: ("vendors"."billing_cycle_started_at" IS NULL) = ("vendors"."billing_cycle_ends_at" IS NULL) AND ("vendors"."billing_cycle_ends_at" IS NULL OR "vendors"."billing_cycle_ends_at" > "vendors"."billing_cycle_started_at")

vendors_dues_notice_check.name: vendors_dues_notice_check
vendors_dues_notice_check.value:
("vendors"."dues_notice_opened_at" IS NULL) = ("vendors"."dues_due_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("vendors"."dues_due_at" IS NULL) = ("vendors"."dues_amount_npr" IS NULL)
        AND ("vendors"."dues_amount_npr" IS NULL OR "vendors"."dues_amount_npr" > 0)
        AND ("vendors"."dues_due_at" IS NULL OR "vendors"."dues_due_at" > "vendors"."dues_notice_opened_at")
